name: Product gallery
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Product gallery. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Gallery mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for gallery mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Main media ratio
settings.info: Width divided by height as a percentage; 125 produces a 1.25:1 frame.
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust main media ratio. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.
